result.rationale: The diff adds `before_validation do self.host.sub!(...) end` in embeddable_host.rb with no nil guard; creating a host without a host value (e.g. controller assigns nil) would raise NoMethodError instead of a validation failure. The normalization mismatch is also real from the diff: lookup uses `where("lower(host) = ?", host)` but nothing downcases the stored host, so e.g. 'EvilTrout.com' would never match its own record. Both mechanisms are visible in the diff, though the nil case requires an input path the diff doesn't fully demonstrate.
